name: usage-monitor
description: Live token, cost and tool-call accounting for the session and every subagent: status line, /usage-monitor pane, and a toast when a subagent finishes. Can also report to a local usage-monitor API for history and a web dashboard (off by default).

apiSocket.title: API socket
apiSocket.description: Optional. Absolute path of the usage-monitor API's Unix socket, for example /run/user/1000/usage-monitor.sock (id -u prints your uid). Leave empty to disable reporting. See the mod's README.
